datasets.name: Derived: Hinglish token frequencies
datasets.description: Token counts over the Hinglish sentence pool. Supplies observed romanisation variants for the FR-2 script normaliser and negation handler (e.g. nahi / nahin / nhi all appear).
datasets.url: (derived locally from the Hinglish corpora above)
datasets.license: Derived from apache-2.0 and cc-by-sa-3.0 sources; treat the derived file as cc-by-sa-3.0 (share-alike).
caveats: Movie-domain dialogue. A word-boundary scan for health cues (dard, bukhar, neend, chakkar, dawai, ...) matched 1 of 6,707 sentences, and that one was a false positive.
Use for surface realism and normalisation only. Health cue examples must come from the synthetic note generator plus a hand-built lexicon reviewed by a Hindi speaker.

datasets.name: Derived: vitals reference, 60+
datasets.description: Age-band x sex summary stats and a row-level joint sample for SBP, DBP, weight, BMI, HbA1c and fasting glucose. Calibrates the synthetic cohort generator.
datasets.url: (derived locally from the NHANES files above)
caveats: NHANES age is top-coded at 80, so the 80+ band is all exactly 80 and understates spread in the oldest seniors.
US survey population, not Indian. Use for plausible ranges and covariance structure, not for claims about Indian seniors.
No SpO2 in these files. SpO2 must be synthesised from published ranges and flagged as such.
Cross-sectional: gives between-person spread, not the within-person day-to-day variance Layer B needs. Within-person drift is a generator parameter, documented separately.

datasets.name: SisFall
datasets.description: Accelerometer and gyroscope traces for falls and activities of daily living. 4505 trials across 38 subjects; 973 trials come from participants aged 60-75.
datasets.citation: Sucerquia, A., Lopez, J.D., Vargas-Bonilla, J.F. SisFall: A Fall and Movement Dataset. Sensors 2017, 17(1), 198. Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22212281.
caveats: Falls are simulated by volunteers onto mattresses. No dataset of real unplanned falls in seniors exists; a model trained here will not transfer cleanly to real falls, and the write-up must say so.

Only 1 of the 15 elderly participants (SE06) performed falls, 75 trials; the other 14 did ADLs only, for safety. So 1,723 of the 1,798 fall trials come from adults aged 19-30, and the age group most at risk is nearly absent from the positive class. Split by subject and report elderly performance separately.
Sensors are waist-mounted at 200 Hz, not a phone in a pocket. Expect a domain gap against any real deployment.

datasets.name: UCI HAR (Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones)
datasets.description: Smartphone accelerometer/gyroscope windows labelled with six activities. Derived file marks each window sedentary or active for the inactivity signal.
datasets.citation: Anguita, D., Ghio, A., Oneto, L., Parra, X., Reyes-Ortiz, J.L. A Public Domain Dataset for Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones. ESANN 2013. UCI Machine Learning Repository.
caveats: Volunteers aged 19-48, not seniors. Gait and posture transitions differ materially in older adults.
Waist-mounted phone in a lab protocol; real seniors may not carry a phone at all, which is why inactivity is inferred from call and check-in silence as the primary signal.

datasets.name: openFDA drug labels (geriatric subset)
datasets.description: Drug-interaction, warning and geriatric-use text for 18 drugs common in geriatric prescribing.
datasets.license: Public domain (US Government work); openFDA terms apply
datasets.citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. openFDA Drug Label API, accessed 2026-10-27.
caveats: openFDA carries FDA's own disclaimer: not for making decisions about medical care. Use it to flag a pair for human review only.
US labelling. Indian formulations, brand names and dosing differ.
Free text, not a structured interaction graph. Any interaction check built on it is keyword matching and must route to a human.
Never surfaces to a senior or family member -- a drug-interaction string is diagnostic-adjacent and belongs to the coordinator view.
